title: Cosmic Duck Over Throne
description: A giant glowing purple duck with a fiery cosmic crown floats inside a luminous orb above a dark fantasy landscape. Below, a blue skeletal queen with green hair sits on an ornate purple throne wearing a golden crown, surrounded by five small crowned skeleton figures with glowing eyes, glowing orbs, and butterflies against a starry background with galaxies and mountains.
prompt: A giant spectral purple duck with glowing white eyes and a flaming crown of galaxies and nebulae floats inside a luminous purple orb in a dark night sky filled with swirling colorful galaxies and stars. Below on a throne sits a blue skeletal queen with long flowing green hair wearing a golden crown, gesturing with one hand. Five small crowned black skeletons with glowing red eyes stand beside her. Dark mountains in the background, glowing orbs, butterflies, and dripping effects, intricate dark fantasy style with vibrant cosmic colors.
